summary: Kerb with cars parked, backing onto netball courts; boathouse opposite is non-residential.

best_section.where: South kerb alongside the netball courts, opposite the boathouse

drivers.seclusion: Netball courts and palms on the kerb side; boathouse across the road is non-residential. No dwellings mapped or seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Open road with a line of parked cars at the kerb; 35 m gives room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Riverside drive, moderate traffic; van stands in the parking lane.
drivers.convention: A row of cars parked along this kerb in QLD and some in Esri, so a van blends in.

flags: Low-lying: about 4.8 m, 106 m from Brisbane River
A No Stopping Any Time sign lies near the western end
Courts and boathouse busy at times
Slope up to 3.8% near the far end, flat at the best section
sun_shade: Palms give partial shade from the south; open to morning sun from the east.
cannot_judge: Exact reach of the No Stopping sign
